organization_schema.name: SmartFunction
organization_schema.description: UK founder-led studio that designs and builds bespoke business apps, AI and workflow automation, sales systems and connected operations.

mainEntity.name: What kind of businesses do you work with?

acceptedAnswer.text: SmartFunction works with UK organisations that have real operational friction — sales teams, service businesses and commercial operators who need bespoke apps, automation or connected systems rather than another generic SaaS licence.

mainEntity.name: Do you only build AI projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. AI is used where it removes repetitive work with clear ROI. Many projects are bespoke apps, sales systems, integrations or websites. The problem comes first; the technology follows.

mainEntity.name: How long does a project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timelines depend on scope. SmartFunction aims for the smallest useful version first so you see working software early, then improves it with your team rather than waiting for a large big-bang delivery.
Pricing is scoped to the problem. Smaller projects are welcome. Budgets discussed on the contact form are optional; SmartFunction replies with honest questions before proposing work.
